src.retarget: trunk: raw sim segq (float32, bit-identical up to sign) through the carriers; legs/arms: sim physics=True joint directions with a constant rest alignment and soft ROM clamps; feet locked to the deck while the sim feet are planted (t <= 1.680 s), then deck contact from the sim's ground contacts; head: sim head rotation over the neck chain
src.note: Simulated faint: ThunderSim SYNC seed 33 (physics=True ragdoll limbs) retargeted onto the Anny body. The four trunk segment orientations are the simulated IMU orientations, exact; pelvis position and limbs are reconstructed from the simulated joints with deck contact.
